sources.title: Zhujiajiao Water Town: A Detail-Packed Guide from Shanghai
sources.content:
Zhujiajiao, located in Shanghai's Qingpu district, is the most famous of several water towns around Shanghai. It is considered the best-preserved water town and super easy to do as a day trip.

The town sits on the outskirts of Shanghai, accessible via public transportation. Autumn is particularly scenic due to ginkgo trees.

Two pass options: Standard Pass covers select gardens and galleries; Complete Pass includes additional temples. Visitors can visit Zhujiajiao for free though individual site fees apply.

Free Areas: Canal system and Yongan Bridge, Fangsheng Bridge, Great North Street (shopping district), Four Cool Bridges, Qing Dynasty Post Office.

Paid Attractions: Kezhi Garden, Garden of Inseparable Hearts, Yuanjin Buddhist Temple, City God Temple, Tea houses.

The town features traditional shops selling local sauces and medicines. Tea culture remains central with historic teahouses. Despite heavy restoration, Zhujiajiao remains the best-preserved water town in the Shanghai region.

sources.title: Zhujiajiao Ancient Town: Travel Tips & FAQs 2026
sources.content:
Zhujiajiao Water Town is the most famous of several water towns around Shanghai, with a history of more than 1700 years. It is considered one of if not THE best-preserved water towns.

Metro Line 17 to Zhujiajiao Station, then head north on foot for approximately 15 minutes. A ticket from centre of Shanghai costs 8 RMB and there are English signs throughout.

Best Time: Avoid weekends and public holidays (Chinese New Year, Mid Autumn Festival, Golden Week). Visit on a weekday either early or late in the day. Avoid busy summer months; visit during Spring or Autumn.

Fangsheng Bridge: Dating back to 1571, the longest and tallest stone bridge in Zhujiajiao, Shanghai's largest stone arch bridge with five arches.

North Street: Ancient street with representative Ming and Qing Dynasty buildings, only one kilometer long.

Kezhi Garden: Largest garden complex spanning 96.7 acres with three sections: main hall, garden area, artificial hill.

Only by taking a hand-operated boat and walking in the old street can you truly appreciate Zhujiajiao's charm. Enjoy Suzhou pingtan at Jiangnan No 1 Tea House.

Free to explore and walk around. Beware of free tour guides (sales traps). Bargain while shopping—prices are often inflated.

sources.title: Ultimate Travel Guide to Zhujiajiao Water Town in 2026
sources.content:
Zhujiajiao Ancient Town is located in Qingpu district of Shanghai, right on the edge of the city's border. The ancient water town is well-known throughout the country.

Transportation: Metro Line 17 to Zhujiajiao Station. The town is a popular day trip destination from Shanghai.

Key attractions include canals, traditional architecture, and historic stone bridges. The town offers a glimpse into traditional water town life with opportunities for boat rides, tea tasting, and exploring ancient streets.

sources.title: One day in Zhujiajiao Ancient Town - Shanghai Government
sources.content:
Zhujiajiao Ancient Town is a well-preserved water town in Shanghai's Qingpu district. The town features canals, bridges, and traditional architecture from the Ming and Qing Dynasties.

Visitors can explore historic streets, visit temples and gardens, ride traditional boats, and sample local cuisine. The town is accessible via Metro Line 17.

sources.title: 朱家角古镇旅游区_百度百科
sources.content:
朱家角古镇旅游区位于上海市青浦区，地处江、浙、沪两省一市交界处，总面积49.8平方公里。

始建于三国时期，宋元成市，明万历年间正式建镇。考古发现表明该地区有新石器时代至战国时期的文化遗存。镇内现存明清宅院四五百处，包括36座古桥和千余栋明清建筑。

核心景观：放生桥（江南最大五孔石拱桥，建于1571年）、北大街（沪上第一明清街）、课植园（占地96亩的庄园式园林）、报国寺和城隍庙等历史遗存。

以衣被天下的标布业和米业闻名，长街三里，店铺千家。民间有三泾不如一角的说法，指朱家角商业地位突出。

2004年批准为国家AAAA级旅游景区。2024年接待游客547万人次，其中30%为境外游客。

2020年启动5A级景区创建，新建游客中心、生态停车场及智慧导览系统。特色美食包括鳝糊面、羊肉面等。

sources.title: How to Visit Zhujiajiao: Shanghai's Ancient Water Town
sources.content:
Zhujiajiao is a charming water town that makes for a perfect day trip from Shanghai. The town is easily accessible via Metro Line 17 and offers a peaceful escape from the bustling city.

It is completely free to explore and walk around Zhujiajiao unless you want to visit some buildings which have a small entry fee. The main attractions include historic bridges, canal-side walks, and traditional tea houses.

Tips: Visit on weekdays to avoid crowds. Try the local street food. Take a boat ride on the canals for a different perspective of the town.

sources.title: Zhujiajiao Ancient Town Official Website
sources.content:
Zhujiajiao Ancient Town is located in Qingpu District of Shanghai, with a history spanning over 1,700 years. The town features well-preserved Ming and Qing Dynasty architecture, 36 ancient stone bridges, and a network of canals.

Key attractions include Fangsheng Bridge (1571, Shanghai's largest five-arch stone bridge), North Street (best-preserved Ming-Qing commercial street), Kezhi Garden (96-acre estate garden), and the historic Qing Dynasty Post Office.

The town offers boat rides, tea houses, traditional crafts, and local cuisine. Free entry to the town itself; individual attractions may charge small fees.

Accessible via Metro Line 17 to Zhujiajiao Station. Best visited on weekdays to avoid crowds.
